aliases: hashicorp certified terraform authoring and operations professional

domains.name: Use the Terraform CLI Outside of Core Workflow

exam_name: HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Authoring and Operations Professional
exam_rules: Closed-book. No notes or documentation. No access to HashiCorp products during exam. Proctor monitors via webcam.
id_requirements: Government-issued photo ID with name and photograph. Name must match PSI registration exactly.

lifecycle.summary: Confirmed current on the issuer host on 2026-09-14: HashiCorp lists two Terraform certifications - 'Terraform Associate (004)' and 'HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Authoring and Operations Advanced' (Terraform 1.6, lab-based, 4 hours, $295, 'Register for the exam'); no retirement wording.

official_study_resources.notes: Free official tutorials and study guides on developer.hashicorp.com
official_study_resources.title: HashiCorp Learn (Developer Portal)

prerequisites.description: Terraform Associate certification recommended before attempting Professional

renewal_options: Certifications valid for 2 years. Renew by retaking the current version of the exam.

retake_policy.notes: Wait 7 days before retaking. Full exam fee required for retake.

testing_centers.notes: Online proctored via PSI. In-person testing also available at PSI test centers.
